summary: Tested edit mode pre-fill for tags and photos (bug fix validation). Found and fixed a race condition in loadCategories that was preventing tags from rendering in Step 2. Also discovered Metro CI mode (CI=true) was serving stale bundles, required service restart to serve updated code. All core edit mode pre-fill features now working.

ui_bugs.issue: Close button (X) in edit mode at step 0 calls router.back() which navigates to /map instead of back to the tagPoint detail page. This is because /(tabs)/create is a TAB route - navigating to it replaces the tab stack rather than pushing to history.

action_items: Back navigation from edit mode: router.back() from step 0 goes to /map instead of /tag-point/{pointId}. Fix: use router.replace('/tag-point/' + pointId) when in edit mode instead of router.back().
CI=true in supervisor expo config disables Metro hot reload - code changes after startup require service restart. Consider removing CI=true from expo supervisor config for development environment.
critical_code_review_comments: Race condition in loadCategories FIXED: Added loadCategoriesVersionRef (useRef) to discard stale API responses when domain changes. Backend confirmed: dom_sport API (72ms) arrives AFTER dom_coaching (57ms), overwriting coaching categories before the fix.

CI=true in expo supervisor config disables Metro file watching/hot reload. Any code changes after Expo service starts are NOT picked up until service restart + cache clear. This is a critical dev environment issue.
The fix for tags (setSelectedTagIds called directly in pre-fill effect) is correct. The fix for images (image_url fallback in handleEdit) is correct.
updated_files: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/create.tsx (added loadCategoriesVersionRef + race condition guard in loadCategories)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Edit mode pre-fill for tags and photos is now WORKING. Race condition in loadCategories was fixed with a version counter ref. Two issues remain: (1) Close button in edit mode (step 0) navigates to /map instead of detail page - needs router.replace('/tag-point/'+pointId) when isEditMode; (2) CI=true in expo supervisor config breaks hot reload - requires restart after each code change. Metro was cleared and service restarted 3 times during this iteration.

bug_1_photos_not_showing.root_cause: handleEdit in [id].tsx was not using image_url fallback when point.images=[] (empty array). The fix uses allImages = parsedImages.length > 0 ? parsedImages : (point.image_url ? [point.image_url] : []).

bug_2_tags_not_showing.root_cause: Two concurrent loadCategories API calls (dom_sport on mount, dom_coaching on pre-fill). dom_sport (72ms) was slower than dom_coaching (57ms), arriving LAST and overwriting coaching categories in React state. This left categories=sport_data while selectedTagIds had coaching tag IDs, resulting in selectedTags=[].
bug_2_tags_not_showing.fix_applied: Added loadCategoriesVersionRef = useRef(0). In loadCategories(), increment version before API call, only call setCategories if version still matches (discards stale dom_sport response). Also E1's fix of calling setSelectedTagIds directly in pre-fill effect (not via editTagsRef) is correct.
bug_2_tags_not_showing.status: FIXED by combination of E1's fix + T1's loadCategories race condition fix

env_issue_ci_mode.root_cause: CI=true in expo supervisor config disables Metro's file watching. Code changes after Expo startup are served from in-memory cache (old bundle) until service restart + cache clear.
env_issue_ci_mode.reproduction: Modify any .tsx file -> page.goto to app -> old code is served (changes not reflected)
env_issue_ci_mode.fix: Remove CI=true from /etc/supervisor/conf.d/expo.conf or set CI=false
